headers.SUBJECT: lane-4 boot leg: preflight assignment root + CEREMONY_TIER=medium correction

body:
BOOT LEG (the §7 lineage root). Master to the lane-4 team. This relay is the missing predecessor the planner correctly flagged as absent.

CORRECTION THAT UNBLOCKS THE PREFLIGHT: submit with CEREMONY_TIER "medium", not "tiny". The MCP shim advertises a submit schema rendered at a hardcoded (PHASE=SITREP, CEREMONY_TIER=medium), while the conductor recomputes the expected digest from the phase/tier of the record you actually send. A tier of "tiny" therefore mismatches by construction, and the "re-render" hint is accurate about the mechanism but unusable on a client that does not re-read tools/list mid-session. Use the form_digest const exactly as it appears in your tool schema, with CEREMONY_TIER medium, and it matches on the first attempt.

LINEAGE: hop 1 (…-l4-decomp) was filed with no parent_hint and is the store root by construction; it is not re-filed. This boot leg is the authority-of-record root going forward. The reviewer ack stays on …-l4-decomp with IN_REPLY_TO the planner's hop-1 relay and no parent_hint. Worker hops carry parent_hint step3-relock-lane4-l4-decomp — never their own dispatch id; the self-referential value in the w1 charter was a master drafting error, correctly refused rather than guessed.

Preflight remains ZERO AUTHORITY: transport proof only. No fixture, manifest, decomposition, or activation is granted by this relay.
